facts.anchor: Aiden had made a mistake in writing Emily a letter. What madness had possessed him to do that? She wasn’t the letter-writing sort, that much was clear from her reply, and leaving a paper trail was idiotic. His brain had been addled by infatuation and he’d lost the run of himself.

facts.anchor: Emily was dead, impossible but true, the afterimage of her body impossible to shift. He could run all he wanted – and right now, after leaving her room, it was all he could think to do – but the letter placed him with her on the night of her death.
